wizard.shuffleInfo: Shuffle tournaments don't use fixed teams. Players will be automatically balanced into teams for each match based on their Skill Ratings.
wizard.shuffleRounds: This shuffle tournament will have approximately {{rounds}} (one per selected map).
wizard.volumeAlert: With {{teams}} in a {{type}} {{format}} tournament, this bracket will have approximately {{matches}} across {{rounds}} (up to {{maps}} total).

wizard.playerRegistrationInfo_other: Players will be registered after tournament creation. Each map selected represents one round of matches ({{count}} rounds total).

overtime.modeHelper: Standard overtime plays extra segments until a team finishes ahead. "Draws allowed" ends a tied map as a draw, while "no draws" decides it by total team damage.
overtime.tooltip: Control overtime behaviour and how ties at max rounds are handled. These settings are passed through to MatchZy as overtimeMode/overtimeSegments and share the same semantics as shuffle tournaments and manual matches.
overtime.shuffleTooltip: Control overtime behavior for shuffle matches and how ties are decided at max rounds. When overtime is disabled, tied matches can either remain draws or be decided by total team damage, depending on which option you choose.
overtime.segmentsHelper: Optional: limit the number of overtime segments. Leave empty for MatchZy default.
overtime.segmentsHelperValue_one: Limit overtime to {{count}} segment. Ties after overtime are decided by total team damage.
overtime.segmentsHelperValue_other: Limit overtime to {{count}} segments. Ties after overtime are decided by total team damage.

grandFinal.label: Grand Final

options.simple: Simple – single Grand Final between winners and losers bracket champions
options.none: None – winners bracket final decides the tournament (no Grand Final)
options.double: Double – bracket‑reset style (currently behaves like Simple; full reset support is planned)

grandFinal.helper: Controls how the champions of the winners and losers brackets meet at the end of the tournament.

mapPool.shuffleBody: All selected maps will be played in sequence. Each map represents one round of matches. The number of maps you choose determines the number of rounds that will be played.
mapPool.shuffleSelected: You have selected {{maps}}, so {{rounds}} will be played.

formatStep.shuffleInfo: Shuffle tournaments use Best of 1 format. Each match is a single map.

shuffleConfig.subtitle: Match Rules & Settings
shuffleConfig.teamSizeTooltip: Number of players per team. Common options: 4v4, 5v5, 6v6. Minimum 2 players, maximum 10 players per team.
shuffleConfig.teamSizeHelper: Number of players per team (default: 5 for 5v5, range: 2-10)
shuffleConfig.maxRoundsTooltip: Maximum number of rounds per match. This value is passed directly to MatchZy as mp_maxrounds. Example: 6 = MR6, 24 = MR24.
shuffleConfig.maxRoundsHelper: Match plays up to {{maxRounds}} rounds; winner is first to {{winRounds}} rounds
shuffleConfig.maxRoundsHelperEmpty: Maximum number of rounds per match (default: 24, max: 30)
shuffleConfig.eloTemplateTooltip: Choose how ELO is calculated for this tournament. By default, the 'Pure Win/Loss' template only uses match result (win/loss); stats are tracked but do not change ELO. Other templates are optional and add stat-based adjustments on top of the OpenSkill win/loss change if you want Excel-style behavior.
shuffleConfig.eloTemplateHelper: Pure Win/Loss (default): only match result affects ELO. Player stats are still recorded for leaderboards and exports, but they do not change the rating unless you select a custom template.

game.title: Which game?

basics.title: What is it called?
basics.lede: Give the tournament a name players will recognise, and pick how ratings change.

format.title: How is it played?
format.lede: Pick the bracket and how long each series is. You can change this until the tournament starts.

maps.lede: Pick the map pool. Series use the veto to choose their maps from it.
maps.ledeShuffle: Pick the maps in the order they are played. Each map is one round.

eventPage.title: What goes on the event page?
eventPage.lede: Optional. Shown to players and visitors on the public Overview page.

game.label: Game

integrationDescriptions.cs2: Matches run on your own CS2 servers with the Auto Tournament CS2 plugin.
integrationDescriptions.manual-report: No servers. Teams play the match themselves and a captain reports the result.

basics.ratingHelp: How player ratings change after each match in this tournament.

format.label: Format

types.single_elimination: Lose once and you're out. Fastest.
types.double_elimination: A second chance in the lower bracket.
types.swiss: Teams play several rounds against similar records.
types.round_robin: Everyone plays everyone. Best for small groups.
types.shuffle: Solo sign-up. New balanced teams each round.

grandFinalHelp.simple: The winners and losers bracket champions meet in one grand final.
grandFinalHelp.double: Bracket reset. For now it is played like one grand final; full reset support is planned.
grandFinalHelp.none: No grand final: the winners bracket final decides the tournament.

format.teamsHelpPowerOfTwo: Elimination brackets need {{counts}} teams. Used for the summary until you pick teams.

maps.vetoCustom: This tournament has a custom veto order for {{format}}.
maps.vetoShuffle: Shuffle has no veto: the maps are played in this order, one per round.

eventPage.draftNote: Saved with the tournament when you create it.

review.unsaved: You have unsaved changes. Save them (the bracket is generated again) or discard them before starting.

manualReport.title: Manual reporting
manualReport.help: Auto Tournament cannot watch this game, so the teams tell it what happened.
manualReport.seriesLengthHelp: How many games a series is. The first team to win more than half of them takes the match.
manualReport.gameLabelHelp: What to call it in the report form. Leave empty for “{{game}}”.
manualReport.allowDrawHelp: Allow a game, and so a series, to end level. Leave off for a bracket, where somebody has to go through.

confirmationHelp.opponent: The other team's captain has to agree before the match is settled. They can dispute it instead, which sends it to an admin.
confirmationHelp.none: A captain's report settles the match on its own. Quick, and worth it only where nobody is likely to disagree.

manualReport.confirmTimeoutHelp: How long the opponent has before the deadline is reached. 1440 is a day.
manualReport.confirmTimeoutNone: No deadline: the report waits for an answer.

timeoutActionHelp.auto_confirm: The report is taken as reported, and the bracket moves on without anybody waiting.
timeoutActionHelp.escalate: The match is handed to an admin, who decides it on the Disputes page.
